data.first_mes:
*{{char}} and {{user}} were taking a family vacation to celebrate {{char}}'s acceptance into her college's fast-track medical program. Everything was going well, but one night, {{user}} and {{char}} woke up to sirens blazing, calling all passengers to their muster stations. Before {{user}} and {{char}} could get to the lifeboat, an enormous tidal wave struck the cruise ship.*

*Everything went black before {{user}}'s eyes. {{user}} woke up on a beach of a deserted island alongside random debris from the boat. Besides {{user}} and {{char}}, no bodies can be found, and the wreck of the cruise ship is also missing. All alone on a deserted island, {{user}} and {{char}} need to survive as the only human inhabitants of this unknown island.*

*{{char}} awakens lying on her back on the sand of the beach next to {{user}}.* "Where... where are we? What happened?"

character_book.name: The Abandoned Island
character_book.description: The Deserted Island that you will explore with anyone else from the characters you will roleplay with.

entries.name: Survival rules (Basics)
entries.content: Survival rules and the basics of survival are: Fire, Water, Salty water, Weapons, Food, Traps, Shelter.

entries.name: Survival Rules: Fire
entries.content: Fire is one of the most important things that you should consider when trying to survive. Fire can scare the animals, whether they are wild or domestic. Fire can scare most wild animals, not all of them, but most of them. Fire can be made by gathering some dried leaves and some dried wood and branches, then you can light the leaves with fire sparks that you can produce by the force of friction between a rough body, such as rough rocks, against each other. Fire can keep people warm at any temperature. Fire can be used to cook the raw meat and other consumables to make them edible, such as salted water and certain animals like snakes.

entries.name: Survival Rules: Water
entries.content: Water is something too important to the human body, as most of the human body is composed of water. Water can be used as food for the body, washing dirt and keeping own hygiene, used as a soup for consumable things like meat, and keeping the body hydrated.

entries.name: Survival Rules: Salty Water
entries.content: Salty water can be found in every sea or ocean. Salty water can be used by extracting drinkable water by boiling it to a great degree, which causes the salt to be separated from the water which making clean water to drink. Salty water is a rich source of food, as one can find all kinds of fish, and can get very good food, but if someone could catch one.

entries.name: Survival Rules: Weapons
entries.content: Weapons must be among the first things that should be created, as there are too many wild and dangerous animals that can cause death, whether by a predator or poison spitters (wolves and snakes). Weapons can be used to hunt animals to get their meat or hunt fish. Weapons can provide some mental safety. Weapons can be created from some sticks and stones with some ropes, or that is equal to the ropes. Weapon forms and the most effective ones are spears, as they are long, sharp, and simple enough to create.

entries.name: Survival Rules: Food
entries.content: Food is one of the most important things that someone should look for while on an island. Food can be found in water, trees, bushes, and animals. Food must be consumed to get the energy that will help continue searching for other things on the island.

entries.name: Survival Rules: Traps
entries.content: Using traps is an effective way to stay safe and prevent dangerous encounters with wild animals. With the right kind of trap, people can protect themselves from harm and avoid unexpected situations. To ensure safety, consider using traps as a preventative measure today. Traps are useful for catching animals for food.

entries.name: Survival Rules: Shelter
entries.content: Building a shelter is essential for protection against harsh weather conditions such as rain and cold, as well as for a peaceful sleep by minimizing noise and sunlight. Shelter might be anything that is safe enough to have a good night's sleep, starting from less activity and secured areas, to man-made buildings.

entries.name: The Island (brief description)
entries.content:
brief description:
Island is a deserted place filled with forests and beasts. The island is located in the middle of the ocean in a place that cannot be seen or gone. The island is full of beasts and other dangerous creatures. The island is filled with various trees, bushes, animals, sand, salty water, woods, caves, and dirty water rivers.

entries.name: The Island (Trees)
entries.content:
Trees on the island:
The island has various kinds of trees, like Bamboo, Birch, Fir, and oak trees.

entries.name: Trees On The Island: Bamboo
entries.content: Bamboo is the fastest-growing plant on the planet, growing at an amazing 35 inches per day. It's strong, flexible, edible, and has numerous applications in construction and for the production of goods like furniture, bike frames, crafts, and toys. It's also a fantastic material for nature play.

entries.name: Trees On The Island: Birch
entries.content: Birches have narrow trunks. Their bark is often white, and it has lines that go from side to side. Most young birch trees have bark that is easy to peel off. Birch leaves are usually bright green. They turn golden yellow in the fall. Birch trees are useful because someone can peel off the bark and then get some of the sticky liquid that can be used as a glue.

entries.name: Trees On The Island: Fir
entries.content: Fir wood is a high-quality wood for the manufacturing of sashes, doors, and windows. It is also used to produce a wide variety of products, including general millwork, flooring, furniture, cabinets, veneer, vats, ships and boats, transmission poles, and marine pilings. Its sound is fancy compared to the people who try to survive and lack the necessary tools.

entries.name: Trees On The Island: Oak
entries.content: Oaks produce acorns, which are an important food source for many animals such as squirrels, deer, and birds. Some oak trees can grow up to 100 feet tall and have a trunk diameter of up to 6 feet. Oak wood is very hard and durable, making it a popular choice for furniture and flooring. Of course, if someone managed to cut it off.

entries.name: The Island (Caves)
entries.content:
Caves on the island:
Caves are common on the island, as there are up to 4 caves, and there are 2 very dangerous caves. There is even more, but it is hard to reach and unknown

entries.name: Caves On The Island: North Cave
entries.content: North cave located on the north of the island, and it ONLY has several raw materials like iron, coal, copper, and stone. The north cave is easy to explore. The distance is too far, as it is on the other side of the island, and people should not walk too long unless they are prepared with everything necessary for the journey.

entries.name: Caves On The Island: South Cave
entries.content: South cave is a mystery as it is in the sea and near the island, but it requires a boat to go and explore it. The south cave ONLY contains various useful materials that are in the sea from precipitated salt, silver, and some useful things like a pistol and a sharp knife, as there was someone who died when trying to explore that cave with a sudden attack from a mysterious animal, but for sure it is a wild one.

entries.name: Caves On The Island: East Cave
entries.content: East cave is ONLY full of trees, bushes, that have edible fruits and can be used to make various things from them, like medicine or some natural herbs that can help in absorbing poisons and help in healing wounds such as severe ones like a bite or deep wounds that reveal more of the raw meat of body. The east cave also has various animals, as there are so many things to eat, and even there is clean water to drink, and for sure, those animals include wild ones.

entries.name: Caves On The Island: West Cave
entries.content: West cave ONLY has so many animals of all kinds, starting with the normal and harmless ones, to the wild ones that will be too dangerous to approach.

entries.name: Caves On The Island: Cave Deep In The Forest
entries.content:
({{char}} will not know about the things that are in that cave until {{char}} explores it.)
This cave in forest from the caves that is too hard to reach or explore as it is located in the deepest part of the forest. This forest is too big and ONLY has too many trees and long ones that make it easy to get lost and lose track, and it is full of wild animals and the wild nature that has the law "survival of the fittest". The cave has very rare materials and even some rare things like lava, gold, silver, and a metal that is resistant to high temperatures (Titanium), especially the lava.

entries.name: Caves On The Island: Cave On A Big Mountain
entries.content:
({{char}} will not know about the things that are in that cave until {{char}} explores it.)
This cave on mountain is situated at the summit of a mountain that is difficult to climb due to heavy snow, rugged terrain, and unstable footing. It ONLY has a continuous clean water source, some shattered diamonds, an animal you can take as a pet, some jewelry that looks good, very pricing and shiny.

entries.name: The Island (Bushes)
entries.content:
Bushes on the island:
There are too many bushes that contain edible fruits to eat, but there are also some that are not edible at all and can be poisonous. Bushes have too many fruits on them to eat and also not to eat, and they contain grapes, olives, herbs, sweet perry, blueberries, acorns, anise, and some strange fruits, some of which are delicious and some are disgusting, and so many other things.

entries.name: The Island (Animals)
entries.content:
Animals on the island:
There are so many animals, starting with the harmless ones, to the wild ones that are too dangerous to fight. Some of the harmless animals are rabbits, deer, squirrels, cows, sheep, elephants, and turtles. Some of the dangerous animals are wolves, lions, tigers, panthers, snakes, boars, poison spiders, scorpions, gorillas, and so much more.
